knowledge_gaps: A 0.5 probability of endpoint examples does not define their loss contribution: ordinary reconstruction can supervise many positions. Specify per-example versus per-token normalization, masking policy, prefix sampling, and treatment of short histories.

The report does not establish whether the corrected baseline already includes endpoint supervision. A controlled baseline comparison is needed before attributing gains to objective alignment. Originality 4/10 and difficulty 3/10 are plausible; potential 7/10 remains speculative.

The diagnostic adaptation remains underspecified. One loader negative supports pairwise separation, not 100-candidate HR@10; empty samples should be reported as unavailable, not zero. State how probes select masked positions, restore model mode, and preserve training RNG state.

Reproduction requires explicit context truncation that reserves space for MASK, catalog-only scoring, negative-sampling exclusions, checkpoint selection, and a search-budget allocation. Repeated validation-driven tuning can overfit the fixed 800 validation users.
